author: reek
body: This test used to print "AI/GeneticAlgorithm OK" and call nothing. It proved the chapter compiled and could not fail for any other reason, which is the shape the lesson index calls L-FALSIF. The same defect in the app copy of this algorithm was real: sort-by-fitness there was once a stub that returned the population unchanged, and the GA still ran, still bred, still mutated, and never selected on fitness at all.

author: reek
body: So the first thing asserted here is that the ranking actually reorders. A selection step that does nothing is invisible from outside, because a GA without selection produces output shaped exactly like a GA with it.
